recent_articles.title: NCCIA uncovers gang selling data of govt officials to foreign entities; four arrested - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA)** arrested four individuals in South Punjab for selling sensitive personal data of government officers to foreign entities. The suspects, identified as Arshad Tariq, Arham Bari, Anam Sabir and Mohammad Rizwan, were allegedly sharing the data with foreign intelligence agencies.  **The NCCIA** is investigating how the information was accessed and has directed government institutions to strengthen data security.

recent_articles.title: Actor Momina Iqbal seeks FIR against PML-N MPA over alleged blackmail and harassment - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Momina Iqbal**, an actor and model, filed a first information report (FIR) against **PML-N MPA Saqib Chadhar** for blackmail, harassment, and death threats.  Iqbal alleged that Chadhar began threatening her after she refused his marriage proposal, claiming he was already married to two women. She also provided evidence of the threats through WhatsApp messages and video calls. Punjab Chief Minister **Maryam Nawaz** warned against any political pressure or attempts to exploit the situation for personal gain, stating the matter will be addressed strictly according to law.

recent_articles.title: ACB books Medchal deputy collector in disproportionate assets case - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Anti-Corruption Bureau (ACB)** officials conducted searches on **Marri Vamshi Mohan**, a Special Grade Deputy Collector, and his associates following allegations of acquiring assets beyond known sources of income. The searches uncovered properties valued at around ₹6.22 crore, including land plots, houses, and vehicles, along with cash and gold ornaments. **Vamshi Mohan** was arrested and remanded to judicial custody.  The investigation is ongoing.

recent_articles.title: Tennessee execution called off after failed lethal injection
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A **Tennessee** execution of Tony Carruthers, convicted of kidnapping and murdering three people in 1994, was postponed after staff were unable to find a suitable vein for the lethal injection.  The **Department of Corrections** stated that while they found a primary IV line, they could not establish a backup line as required by protocol. Governor Bill Lee granted Carruthers a temporary reprieve from execution for one year. The **American Civil Liberties Union (ACLU)** and other advocates have raised concerns about the trial's integrity and called for DNA testing. Kim Kardashian also joined the cause, urging supporters to demand the evidence be tested before it's too late.

recent_articles.title: Indian man sentenced to 15.5 years in prison for gold scam in US, picked 16 gold bars from elderly victims - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Syed M Makki**, a 38-year-old Indian man, was sentenced to 15.5 years in prison for his role in a gold scam targeting elderly victims across the US.  The scheme involved malware that tricked victims into believing they were dealing with legitimate authorities, leading them to liquidate their savings and purchase gold bullion. **Makki** acted as a courier, collecting gold bars from victims and delivering them to co-conspirators. The Justice Department reported that the scam resulted in over $4.75 million in losses for victims.

recent_articles.title: Anmol alias Pinky sent to jail on judicial remand in narcotics, murder cases - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Anmol**, also known as Pinky, an alleged drug queenpin, was sent to jail on a 14-day judicial remand in multiple narcotics cases and a murder case.  She had already been booked in over a dozen criminal cases prior to her arrest earlier this month. **Karachi police** sought the Sindh government's permission to dispatch a team to Punjab to arrest Anmol’s brothers, ex-husbands, and other co-suspects involved in the drug trafficking network. A Lahore court allowed an FIR against **Rana Muhammad Akram**, Anmol’s former husband, who allegedly conducted an illegal raid on Yasmeen Tabassam's house.

recent_articles.title: Twisha Sharma death: Madhya Pradesh government proposes to transfer case to CBI - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Madhya Pradesh** government proposed transferring the dowry death case of Twisha Sharma to the **CBI**. The notification, issued by Home Department Secretary Krishnaveni Desavatu, cites the Delhi Special Police Establishment Act for extending investigative powers to the state.  The case, registered at Katara Hills Police Station, involves allegations of harassment and dowry-related deaths against her husband Samarth Singh and mother-in-law Giribala Singh.

recent_articles.title: Gujarat Police trace 701 missing persons under ‘Operation Milap’ in two weeks - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Gujarat Police** have successfully reunited 701 missing persons with their families through a statewide operation called **Operation Milap**, which ran from May 7 to May 21.  The initiative, aimed at reviewing pending missing person cases, involved analyzing old records and conducting fresh field verifications. The drive also included checking digital records, social media activity, transport locations, and shelter homes, with officials noting some cases were linked to trafficking networks. **Deputy Chief Minister Harsh Sanghavi** stated the government provided resources for the operation.

recent_articles.title: Over 2,000 gather in San Diego to mourn three men killed in mosque attack | Gun Violence News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Over 2,000 people gathered in San Diego to mourn the three men killed in a shooting at the Islamic Center of San Diego. **Amin Abdullah**, **Mansour Kaziha**, and **Nader Awad** were remembered as heroes who delayed and distracted the teenage suspects during the attack on Monday.  The victims' bodies were laid to rest together later that day, with police considering the incident a hate crime. The shooting is currently under investigation.

recent_articles.title: Fake call centres duping U.S. citizens busted in Bengaluru, man from Delhi, another from U.P. arrested - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Karnataka State Cyber Command** officials raided four fake call centers in Bengaluru, uncovering a sophisticated operation that defrauded U.S. citizens by impersonating a prominent American accounting firm. The accused, Prashanth and Akash, allegedly collected millions of rupees from victims through fake tax advice, license renewal services, and counterfeit software keys.  The investigation revealed the use of shell companies to launder money and a network of over 120 employees trained to deceive victims using US accents. **Pronab Mohanty**, Director General of Cyber Command, stated that further investigations will focus on tracing the money trail and identifying bank accounts used in the fraud.

recent_articles.title: Calcutta HC orders setting up SIT of CBI to probe hushing up charges in R G Kar rape-murder case - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Calcutta High Court** ordered the creation of a three-member special investigation team (SIT) from the **CBI** to investigate the death of a trainee doctor at the **RG Kar Medical College and Hospital**. The court's decision follows allegations that evidence was destroyed and attempts were made to downplay the incident. The SIT will focus on the events leading up to the victim's cremation, including potential lapses in the initial investigation by both police and hospital authorities.  The team is expected to file a comprehensive report by June 25th.

recent_articles.title: Assistant Director of Mines in Ranipet relieved of duties - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **D. Mohan**, Director of Geology and Mining, relieved **E. Srinivasarao**, Assistant Director of the Ranipet office, of his duties due to allegations that he demanded ₹2 lakh in cash from a stone quarry operator to relax mining norms. The incident was reported to the Ministry of Natural Resources, Minerals and Mines, headed by Minister **T.K. Prabhu**.  **A. Arumuganainar**, Regional Joint Director of Geology and Mining (Villupuram), will now hold full additional charge of the post of AD of Geology and Mining for Ranipet district.

recent_articles.title: Tennessee governor orders stay of execution after doctor can’t find vein | US news | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Governor Bill Lee** of Tennessee granted a one-year stay of execution for Tony Carruthers, who was scheduled to be executed on Thursday.  Carruthers's lawyers argued that he is mentally incompetent and there was a lack of physical evidence linking him to the 1994 murders. The reprieve came after Carruthers's legal team filed a last-minute appeal citing difficulties locating his vein during the lethal injection attempt, as well as concerns about the physician contracted by Tennessee’s department of corrections.  Carruthers's case has drawn attention due to ongoing questions about his conviction and mental competency, as well as protests against his execution.

recent_articles.title: Boys convicted of rape get non-custodial sentences as judge says they should not be criminalised unnecessarily | UK news | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Three teenage boys, aged 13 to 14 at the time of their crimes, were sentenced to youth rehabilitation orders ranging from 18 months to three years for their roles in a series of knife-point rapes and sexual assaults against two teenage girls. **Judge Nicholas Rowland** stated he wanted to support the boys' reintegration into society and avoid criminalising them unnecessarily due to their young age, low intelligence, and limited understanding of consent.  The judge acknowledged the seriousness of the crimes but emphasized that they were "very young" and had not been in any big trouble before. **Donna Jones**, Hampshire’s police and crime commissioner, expressed concern over the lenient sentences, stating they offer little comfort to the victims.

recent_articles.title: At least 16 people killed in two attacks in northern Honduras | Crime News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: At least 16 people were killed in two separate incidents of gun violence in northern Honduras.  **Edgardo Barahona**, spokesperson for **Honduras’s National Police**, reported that at least 10 workers were shot dead on a palm farm in Rigores, while six officers from the **Anti-Maras, Gangs and Organised Crime Police Directorate (DIPAMPCO)** were killed during an anti-gang operation in Omoa.  **Hector Benjamin Valerio Ardon**, head of Honduras’s Joint Staff of the Armed Forces, pledged to find those responsible for the attacks. The incidents have prompted the **National Police** to issue a statement promising immediate action to capture suspects and protect vulnerable communities.

recent_articles.title: Who is Mohammed Omar, $90-million fraud suspect in Minnesota, who jumped from balcony to evade FBI arrest? - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mohammed Omar**, charged with conspiracy to commit health care fraud and four counts of health care fraud, jumped from a fourth-floor balcony during an FBI arrest attempt in Minnesota on Thursday. **Colin McDonald**, Assistant Attorney General for the National Fraud Enforcement Division, urged the public to help capture Omar, who allegedly operated two companies, North Home Health Care and South Home Health Care, with Ibrahim Bashir Abdi to defraud the government of $90 million through falsified service hours. The scheme involved using disabled individuals as "lottery tickets" to generate millions of dollars for luxury purchases.

recent_articles.title: Chudthebuilder: Judge orders ChudTheBuilder to wear GPS monitor and restrict social media use if released on bond - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Dalton Eatherly**, known online as **ChudTheBuilder**, faces strict new bond conditions after a judge ruled on his possible release from custody. The restrictions, imposed due to serious charges including attempted criminal homicide and firearm offenses, include GPS monitoring, weapon surrender, social media bans, and limited communication.  If released on bond, Eatherly will be closely monitored and must strictly adhere to all court orders.

recent_articles.title: Who is Maurice Shelmon aka Ant Jefe? No Jumper YouTuber and podcaster faces felony murder charge after LAPD arrest - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Maurice Shelmon**, better known online as Ant Jefe, was arrested by the **Los Angeles Police Department** on May 19 in connection with a felony murder case.  Shelmon, a popular podcasting and YouTube personality, had built a large following through his music releases, reaction videos, and appearances on the No Jumper podcast. The arrest has surprised many of his followers, who expressed shock and disbelief during a livestream hosted by **No Jumper** hosts.

recent_articles.title: Chennithala seeks report on parole granted to Periye murder convicts - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Following protests from the families of the victims in the Periye twin murder case, **Kerala Home Minister Ramesh Chennithala** has requested a report on the parole granted to five convicts. The parole order was issued during the final phase of the previous Left Democratic Front government's tenure and the jail authorities clarified that prisoners are generally not allowed to leave during elections.  The family members of the victims plan to meet the Chief Minister and the Home Minister to file a formal complaint against the mass parole granted to the convicts.

recent_articles.title: California hit-and-run: Indian man arrested by ICE after state releases him, 4-year-old victim expected to survive - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Aman Kumar**, an Indian man, was arrested by **ICE** after being released from jail in California on charges of felony hit-and-run following a traffic accident that injured a four-year-old boy.  The incident occurred in April 2026 when Kumar ran over the child while attempting to avoid traffic. The **Department of Homeland Security (DHS)** accused **California** sanctuary politicians of releasing Kumar from jail despite his illegal entry into the US in 2023.

recent_articles.title: Ecuador’s Disappeared | Crime | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ecuadorian** authorities are under scrutiny for the disappearance of at least 50 people detained by security forces since 2024, as investigations into forced disappearances conducted by the military during a drug war intensify.  The **Ecuadorian** government's crackdown on drug cartels has resulted in record killings and heightened concerns about human rights violations. The film "Disappeared Fault Lines" investigates these cases, including the disappearance of Jonathan Villon, a father of three taken by soldiers in broad daylight in December 2024, and the deaths of four boys known as the “Malvinas 4.

recent_articles.title: 5 Indians, 2 US businessmen: Inside India's call center operation that FBI shut down for fraud - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The FBI shut down a call center operation in India that defrauded hundreds of elderly victims across the US and elsewhere. **Adam Young** and **Harrison Gevirtz**, two former CEOs of a telecommunications company, Ringba, pleaded guilty to misprision of a felony for their role in enabling the scam. The investigation revealed that Indian citizens Sahil Narang, Chirag Sachdeva, Abrar Anjum, Manish Kumar, and Jagmeet Singh Virk were convicted of similar charges. **The FBI** is urging consumers to be aware of tech support scams and report any suspicious activity.

recent_articles.title: UK grooming case: 20 jailed for 277 years over rape and abuse of girls between 1995 and 2003 - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Twenty individuals** have been sentenced to a combined 277 years in prison for their roles in a child sexual abuse investigation spanning from 1995 to 2003. **Sajid Majid**, **Manaf Hussain**, and **Tariq Azam** received the longest sentences, with **Majid** receiving 28 years for five counts of rape and three counts of indecent assault.  The **Kirklees District Police** described the investigation as exposing "truly appalling sexual abuse" carried out by "a large number of sexual predators." Detective Chief Inspector Rob Stevens praised the victims' courage in enduring lengthy trials.

recent_articles.title: Indian-origin truck driver Shamsher Singh jailed for 6 years for raping woman he met on dating app in New Zealand - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Shamsher Singh**, a 33-year-old Indian-origin man, was sentenced to six years and nine months in prison for raping a woman he met on a dating app during a late-night freight run. **Singh** assaulted the victim inside his commercial truck while parked on a remote stretch of highway between Nelson and Blenheim in January 2024. The victim accepted an invitation from **Singh** to accompany him on a delivery after connecting online and meeting for lunch in Nelson.  The assault occurred during the return leg of the journey, with the victim being asleep inside the vehicle when **Singh** attacked her.  Judge Harrop noted that **Singh** ignored the victim's distress and showed no remorse, resulting in the full sentence.

recent_articles.title: US lawyers say man on death row could be executed with expired lethal drugs | Death Penalty News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Tennessee** lawyers for Tony Carruthers are concerned the state may use expired lethal injection drugs during his execution on Thursday.  They argue that **TDOC**'s response to their inquiries about drug expiration dates is insufficient and raises concerns about the safety of the execution process. The issue of expired drugs in executions has plagued several states, including Arkansas, Idaho, and Texas, leading to delays or even stops in executions.

recent_articles.title: Police officer catches baby thrown from window of house on fire
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A **police officer** in Kalamazoo, Michigan, rescued a baby from a burning home after the mother threw the infant from a window.  The officer spotted the mother through an upstairs window and instructed her to drop the baby to him. Both the mother and baby were transported to a hospital for evaluation but neither sustained injuries. The cause of the fire is still under investigation by the **Kalamazoo Department of Public Safety**.

recent_articles.title: Man charged with stealing camera equipment from Bondi shooting victim in aftermath of terror attack | New South Wales | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **NSW police** have charged a 35-year-old man with larceny and disposing of stolen property in connection to the Bondi Beach terror attack. The man allegedly stole camera equipment from one of the victims, a retired police officer and photographer, after the December 14th shooting that killed 15 people. During an investigation into the attack, detectives identified the theft and executed a search warrant in Sydney's north-western suburbs where they found stolen property, including a camera, handcuffs, electronic devices, and white crystal powder. The man was granted strict conditional bail to appear before Blacktown local court on June 22nd.

recent_articles.title: SC issues notices to accused in Rawalpindi honour killing case after jirga rejects woman’s marriage choice - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Supreme Court** of Pakistan issued notices to the accused in an honor killing case involving a young woman from Rawalpindi who was murdered after a jirga rejected her choice of marriage. The case stems from an FIR filed by Zia-ur Rehman, alleging his wife's elopement with another man and subsequent murder at the behest of a jirga. **Zafarullah** and **Rafaqat Mehmood**, members of the jirga who were granted bail by the Lahore High Court, are among those facing charges. The Punjab Prosecution Department appealed against the high court's decision, arguing that the accused were fully involved in the crime and posed a threat to witnesses. The case was adjourned until June.

recent_articles.title: Man arrested for murdering woman, dumping body in Tirupalya lake in Anekal taluk - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ratan Das**, a man from Assam, was arrested in connection with the murder of a 47-year-old woman whose body was found floating in **Tirupalya Lake** in Anekal taluk.  Police confirmed that the woman had been strangled and suffocated before being disposed of in thick grass near the lake. The investigation revealed that **Das** had an illicit relationship with the victim and confessed to killing her after pressure to marry. He is currently under judicial custody.

recent_articles.title: Bannu police kill five militants after launching operation in district - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Bannu Police** have killed a highly wanted commander, Hiyatullah, and his accomplice during an operation targeting militants involved in the suicide attack on the Fateh Khel police post.  The **police** claim to have eliminated five terrorists within the last 24 hours following the attack which resulted in the deaths of at least 15 police personnel. The operations were conducted under the special directives of RPO Sajjad Khan and involved intelligence-based operations (IBOs) and specialized police teams. Civil society and local residents praised the **Bannu Police** for their commitment to maintaining law and order, while the **Police Peace Committee** launched an operation titled “Operation Revenge of the Martyrs” with a focus on reclaiming militant hideouts and holding individuals linked to them accountable.

recent_articles.title: Alleged drug queenpin Anmol remanded into police custody till May 22 in narcotics case - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A **judicial magistrate** in Karachi remanded alleged drug queenpin Anmol alias Pinky into police custody until May 22nd.  She was arrested earlier this week for possession of narcotics and an unlicensed weapon, and is already facing multiple criminal charges. The **police** sought her physical custody in a total of 15 cases but were denied in most instances, with some being sent to judicial remand. Anmol claimed she was tortured during custody and that the police are trying to harass her in court.  The investigation into her alleged drug network is ongoing.

recent_articles.title: Two men arrested in London after man run over by van in Birmingham | UK news | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Two men** were arrested in London after arriving for a protest in the capital. The arrests are related to an incident in Birmingham where a man was run over by a van on Thursday evening. **West Midlands police** are investigating the incident, which left a man in his 30s with a broken leg that required surgery.  The van involved in the incident has been recovered and is being examined.

recent_articles.title: Cyberabad police begin search for Bandi Bageerath in Hyderabad and Karimnagar after HC rejects pre-arrest bail plea - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Cyberabad police** intensified their search for **Bandi Bageerath**, accused of sexually assaulting and emotionally manipulating a 17-year-old girl, by conducting searches at his residences in Hyderabad and Karimnagar.  Five police teams were involved in the operation, which included physical checks and surveillance efforts to track his whereabouts. The investigation is ongoing, with discussions about Bageerath surrendering to authorities before being subjected to medical examination and remanded.

recent_articles.title: CBI arrests ‘mastermind’ linked to NEET-UG 2026 biology paper leak - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI)** arrested a biology lecturer, **Manisha Gurunath Mandhare**, for her involvement in the 2026 NEET-UG paper leak case.  **Mandhare**, appointed by the **National Testing Agency (NTA)** as an expert, allegedly disclosed questions and answers from botany and zoology subjects to students through special coaching classes at her residence. The agency has arrested nine individuals in connection with the case, including a chemistry lecturer, **P.V. Kulkarni**, who allegedly leaked chemistry questions.  The CBI is conducting searches across the country and investigating leads related to the distribution of a "guess" paper that closely matched the actual exam paper.

recent_articles.title: At least five people pardoned by Trump for Capitol attack accused of new crimes | US Capitol attack | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ryan Nichols**, a former Capitol rioter pardoned by **Donald Trump** in January 2025, was arrested on May 11th in Texas for brandishing a handgun during a dispute.  Nichols had previously pleaded guilty to his role in the January 6th insurrection and received a prison sentence. He later announced his withdrawal from a congressional race after facing new criminal charges. **Citizens for Responsibility and Ethics in Washington (CREW)** has documented over 30 individuals pardoned by **Trump** who are now accused of committing crimes after their pardons.

recent_articles.title: Adhikari aide killing: CBI conducts searches at multiple locations - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The CBI** conducted searches at multiple locations in connection with the murder of West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari's aide Chandrakant Rath. The agency took over the investigation from the **West Bengal Police**, forming a seven-member special investigation team under a DIG of Special Crime from Delhi.  Rath was shot dead on May 6th, two days after the West Bengal Assembly election results were declared. Three individuals have been arrested in connection with the case, while police believe at least eight people were involved.
